newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle seen steady to up, feeders mixed.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle seen steady to up, feeders mixed.

text.p: CME live cattle futures were expected to open steady to 0.100 cent per lb higher with calls on feeder cattle ranging from 0.100 cent a lb higher to 0.100 lower, livestock analysts said.

Carryover fund and commercial support was seen in live cattle following a firmer tone to cash markets. Boxed beef values rose again Tuesday and packers were seen paying firm to higher prices to obtain live supplies, analysts said.
Demand for beef by retailers is expected to be strong the next few weeks as they vie for cattle to supply retailers with enough beef for upcoming May and June holidays.
However, some analysts noted that futures gains are starting to look overdone. Greater numbers of cattle are expected to become market-ready as the summer unfolds, they added.

Feeder cattle futures calls ranged mixed as higher corn futures indications may offset support from a gain in the latest CME feeder cattle index. Cash feeder markets overall were seen strong as supplies look tighter, analysts said.
The latest CME feeder cattle index advanced $0.18 to $72.13 per cwt.
